vendor: ContractPod Technologies Limited (trading as Leah, formerly ContractPodAi)
product_family: Agentic AI platform for enterprise legal, contract lifecycle management (CLM), procurement, and finance operations. Sub-products: Leah Agentic OS (orchestration), Leah Legal, Leah Agentic CLM, Leah Procurement, Leah Finance.

certifications.name: SOC 1 Type 2 (SSAE-18)
certifications.proof_quote: Leah takes security seriously and conducts annual audits including SSAE-18 SOC 1 Type 2 and SSAE-18 SOC 2 Type 2, with certifications available to customers on request.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2 (SSAE-18)
certifications.proof_quote: Leah takes security seriously and conducts annual audits including SSAE-18 SOC 1 Type 2 and SSAE-18 SOC 2 Type 2, with certifications available to customers on request. [Note: Microsoft 365 App Certification self-attestation by ContractPod Technologies Limited (January 2026) confirms 'SOC 2 Type 2: Yes', but lists most recent cert date as 2021-11-30. Vendor legal page claims annual renewal but more recent public evidence is not available. Certs provided to customers on request only.]

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Vendor's own Microsoft 365 App Certification self-attestation (updated January 2026) explicitly states 'Is the app ISO 27001 certified? No'. AI governance page uses weaker language: 'ISO 27001 Aligned'. Marketing blog and CISO guide list ISO 27001 in a compliance table without the 'aligned' qualifier, which appears to be an over-claim not supported by formal attestation.

certifications.name: ISO 27018
certifications.proof_quote: Vendor's own Microsoft 365 App Certification self-attestation (January 2026) explicitly states 'Does the app comply with ISO 27018? No'.

certifications.name: ISO 27017
certifications.proof_quote: Vendor's own Microsoft 365 App Certification self-attestation (January 2026) explicitly states 'Does the app comply with ISO 27017? No'.

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI Management Systems)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. AI governance page at leahai.com/ai-governance does not mention ISO 42001.

certifications.name: GDPR (compliance posture)
certifications.proof_quote: Our Data Processing Addendum (the DPA) explains how we process data. We include terms for the European Union's Standard Contractual Clauses, for California personal information, and how we transfer and protect data you trust us with. [DPA v4.0, last updated January 4, 2026, incorporates EU Standard Contractual Clauses.]

certifications.name: HIPAA

Blog post claims 'Business Associate Agreements (BAAs) available to meet healthcare client requirements', but the vendor's own Microsoft 365 App Certification self-attestation (January 2026) marks HIPAA as 'N/A'. No formal HIPAA compliance attestation found on vendor domain.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: Vendor's own Microsoft 365 App Certification self-attestation (January 2026) explicitly states 'Has the app been Cloud Security Alliance (CSA Star) certified? No'.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: CISO guide blog post mentions FedRAMP as 'in progress'. Microsoft 365 App Certification self-attestation (January 2026) states 'Is the app FedRAMP compliant? No'.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Vendor's own Microsoft 365 App Certification self-attestation (January 2026) states 'annual PCI DSS assessments: N/A'.

privacy.ai_training_note: Zero data retention policy confirmed with underlying LLM providers: 'Leah enforces zero data retention policies with OpenAI and Anthropic. Your data is processed but never stored by the underlying LLM providers.' Keys managed via Azure Key Vault. Source: leahai.com/ai-governance.
privacy.data_region: Azure-hosted. Customer-selectable regions: North Continental Europe (Ireland, replicated to Netherlands), East US (replicated to West US), Australia East (replicated to Australia Central).

products.name: Leah Agentic OS

products.name: Leah Legal

products.name: Leah Procurement

products.name: Leah Finance

products.notes: Extension product for existing Leah platform customers in finance and shared services.

compare.pricing_model: Enterprise SaaS, custom pricing. Third-party review sources indicate tiered structure starting around $99/user/month (Essentials), $149/user/month (Professional), with Enterprise tier on custom quote. Pricing not publicly confirmed on vendor domain.
compare.data_residency: Customer-selectable Azure regions: EU (Ireland/Netherlands), US (East/West), Australia (East/Central)

flags: ISO 27001 OVER-CLAIM: Marketing blog posts and CISO guide list ISO 27001 in a compliance table as a held certification, but the vendor's own Microsoft 365 App Certification self-attestation (ContractPod Technologies Limited, updated January 2026) explicitly states 'Is the app ISO 27001 certified? No'. The AI governance page uses the weaker phrase 'ISO 27001 Aligned'. AIFOXX must not list ISO 27001 as certified.

HIPAA AMBIGUITY: Blog post claims 'Business Associate Agreements (BAAs) available to meet healthcare client requirements' but the MS365 self-attestation marks HIPAA as 'N/A'. The AI governance page says only 'HIPAA Ready', not 'HIPAA compliant' or 'HIPAA certified'. No formal HIPAA Business Associate Agreement program is documented on the vendor domain beyond the marketing claim.

SOC 2 CERT DATE STALENESS: The most recent SOC 2 Type II cert date recorded in the Microsoft 365 App Certification self-attestation is 2021-11-30. The legal page claims 'annual audits' implying renewal, but no more recent third-party-evidenced cert date is publicly available. Certs are provided to customers on request only.
FEDRAMP IN PROGRESS: CISO guide blog lists FedRAMP as 'in progress'; it is not yet achieved. Do not represent as held.

REBRAND NOTE: ContractPodAi officially rebranded to Leah in January 2026 (BusinessWire announcement 2026-01-05). Legacy domain contractpodai.com redirects to leahai.com. Legal entity remains ContractPod Technologies Limited. Identity confirmed.

NO DEDICATED TRUST CENTER: The vendor does not operate a self-serve trust center portal. The legal page (leahai.com/legal) links to Privacy Statement, DPA, and a Security Data Sheet; the Security Data Sheet is available to customers on request, not publicly downloadable.
